newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch insurer Aegon finalises PGGM property deal.
newsitem.headline: Dutch insurer Aegon finalises PGGM property deal.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon said on Monday it had finalised a deal with Dutch pension fund PGGM, combining their property portfolios.
The deal between Aegon's Real Estate and PGGM's Dutch Real Estate Fund was first announced in September and was then expected to be finalised in the autumn.
Both parties said in September the new combination would have a portfolio valued at five billion guilders in existing real estate and 750 million guilders in new developments.
